description: Labelled pairs for the supersede-suggestion threshold (specs/memkernel-0-17-supersede-and-canonical-hash D3). Hand-written for the purpose; no stored memory or transcript text. 'version': a memory and its newer version on the same subject; 'different': two memories on a related subject that say different things.

pairs.a: Use PostgreSQL 15 for the user database.
pairs.b: Use PostgreSQL 16 for the user database.

pairs.a: Deploy the API service to AWS us-east-1.
pairs.b: Deploy the API service to AWS eu-west-1.

pairs.a: Cache session tokens in Redis with a 30-minute expiry.
pairs.b: Cache session tokens in Redis with a 2-hour expiry.

pairs.a: Use Celery for background jobs.
pairs.b: Use arq for background jobs instead of Celery.

pairs.a: The mobile app targets iOS 16 and later.
pairs.b: The mobile app targets iOS 17 and later.

pairs.a: Log in JSON to stdout and ship logs with Fluent Bit.
pairs.b: Log in JSON to stdout and ship logs with Vector.

pairs.a: Store uploaded images in S3 with a 90-day lifecycle rule.
pairs.b: Store uploaded images in S3 with a 30-day lifecycle rule.

pairs.a: Use REST for the public API; GraphQL is not offered.
pairs.b: Offer GraphQL alongside REST for the public API.

pairs.a: Python code uses a maximum line length of 100 characters.
pairs.b: Python code uses a maximum line length of 120 characters.

pairs.a: Branch names start with feature/, fix/ or chore/.
pairs.b: Branch names start with feat/, fix/, chore/ or docs/.

pairs.a: Commit messages use the imperative mood and stay under 72 characters.
pairs.b: Commit messages use the imperative mood and stay under 50 characters.

pairs.a: Test files live next to the module they test, named test_<module>.py.
pairs.b: Test files live under tests/, mirroring the package layout, named test_<module>.py.

pairs.a: Use snake_case for database column names.
pairs.b: Use camelCase for database column names.

pairs.a: Dates in API responses are ISO 8601 strings in UTC.
pairs.b: Dates in API responses are Unix timestamps in seconds.

pairs.a: Every public function has a Google-style docstring.
pairs.b: Every public function has a NumPy-style docstring.

pairs.a: Feature flags are named with the team prefix, like payments.new_checkout.
pairs.b: Feature flags are named with the ticket number, like PAY-1234_new_checkout.

pairs.a: The staging database runs on db-staging-02.
pairs.b: The staging database runs on db-staging-03.

pairs.a: The build takes about 12 minutes on CI.
pairs.b: The build takes about 7 minutes on CI.

pairs.a: The payments service listens on port 8443.
pairs.b: The payments service listens on port 9443.

pairs.a: The nightly backup job starts at 02:00 UTC.
pairs.b: The nightly backup job starts at 03:30 UTC.

pairs.a: The search index holds about 4 million documents.
pairs.b: The search index holds about 6.5 million documents.

pairs.a: The on-call rotation is weekly, handing over on Mondays.
pairs.b: The on-call rotation is weekly, handing over on Thursdays.

pairs.a: The API rate limit is 100 requests per minute per key.
pairs.b: The API rate limit is 300 requests per minute per key.

pairs.a: To release: tag the commit, push the tag, and the release workflow publishes to PyPI.
pairs.b: To release: bump the version, tag the commit, push the tag, and approve the release workflow before it publishes to PyPI.

pairs.a: To rotate the database password, update it in Vault, then restart the API pods.
pairs.b: To rotate the database password, update it in AWS Secrets Manager, then restart the API pods.

pairs.a: To reproduce the flaky test, run pytest -k checkout -p no:randomly 20 times.
pairs.b: To reproduce the flaky test, run pytest -k checkout --count=50 with pytest-repeat.

pairs.a: To add a migration, run alembic revision --autogenerate and review the script.
pairs.b: To add a migration, run make migration NAME=<name>, which wraps alembic revision --autogenerate, then review the script.

pairs.a: To onboard a developer, create their GitHub account and add them to the backend team.
pairs.b: To onboard a developer, create their GitHub account, add them to the backend team, and grant read access to the staging cluster.

pairs.a: To clear the CDN cache, run the purge-cdn script with the distribution id.
pairs.b: To clear the CDN cache, open the CloudFront console and create an invalidation for /*.

pairs.a: To restart the worker, run systemctl restart worker on the queue host.
pairs.b: To restart the worker, run kubectl rollout restart deployment/worker.

pairs.a: Use PostgreSQL 16 for the user database.
pairs.b: Use Redis for the session store.

pairs.a: Deploy the API service to AWS eu-west-1.
pairs.b: Run the batch jobs on spot instances to cut cost.

pairs.a: Cache session tokens in Redis with a 2-hour expiry.
pairs.b: Encrypt session tokens at rest with KMS.

pairs.a: Use arq for background jobs.
pairs.b: Retry failed background jobs three times with exponential backoff.

pairs.a: The mobile app targets iOS 17 and later.
pairs.b: The Android app targets API level 31 and later.

pairs.a: Log in JSON to stdout.
pairs.b: Keep application logs for 14 days in the log store.

pairs.a: Store uploaded images in S3.
pairs.b: Serve images through CloudFront with signed URLs.

pairs.a: Offer GraphQL alongside REST for the public API.
pairs.b: Version the public REST API in the URL path, like /v2/.

pairs.a: Python code uses a maximum line length of 120 characters.
pairs.b: Python imports are sorted by ruff's isort rules.

pairs.a: Branch names start with feat/, fix/, chore/ or docs/.
pairs.b: Pull requests need one approving review before merge.

pairs.a: Commit messages use the imperative mood.
pairs.b: Squash-merge pull requests into main.

pairs.a: Test files live under tests/, mirroring the package layout.
pairs.b: Unit tests must not touch the network.

pairs.a: Use snake_case for database column names.
pairs.b: Every table has created_at and updated_at columns.

pairs.a: Dates in API responses are ISO 8601 strings in UTC.
pairs.b: API errors return a JSON body with code and message fields.

pairs.a: Every public function has a Google-style docstring.
pairs.b: Type hints are required on every function signature.

pairs.a: Feature flags are named with the team prefix.
pairs.b: Feature flags are removed within two sprints of full rollout.

pairs.a: The staging database runs on db-staging-03.
pairs.b: The production database has two read replicas.

pairs.a: The build takes about 7 minutes on CI.
pairs.b: CI runs on GitHub Actions with Ubuntu runners.

pairs.a: The payments service listens on port 9443.
pairs.b: The payments service is owned by the checkout team.

pairs.a: The nightly backup job starts at 03:30 UTC.
pairs.b: Backups are kept for 35 days.

pairs.a: The search index holds about 6.5 million documents.
pairs.b: The search cluster runs OpenSearch 2.11.

pairs.a: The on-call rotation is weekly.
pairs.b: Pages go to PagerDuty, then to the incidents channel.

pairs.a: The API rate limit is 300 requests per minute per key.
pairs.b: API keys expire after 90 days.

pairs.a: To release: bump the version, tag the commit, push the tag.
pairs.b: To roll back a release, redeploy the previous image tag.

pairs.a: To rotate the database password, update it in Secrets Manager, then restart the API pods.
pairs.b: To restore the database, pick a snapshot in RDS and restore it to a new instance.

pairs.a: To reproduce the flaky test, run pytest -k checkout --count=50.
pairs.b: To run the full test suite locally, start the docker-compose services, then run make test.

pairs.a: To add a migration, run make migration NAME=<name>.
pairs.b: To seed a local database, run make seed.

pairs.a: To onboard a developer, create their GitHub account and add them to the backend team.
pairs.b: To offboard a developer, remove them from the GitHub organisation and revoke their VPN certificate.

pairs.a: To clear the CDN cache, create a CloudFront invalidation.
pairs.b: To add a new domain, request a certificate in ACM and add an alias to the distribution.

pairs.a: To restart the worker, run kubectl rollout restart deployment/worker.
pairs.b: To scale the worker, change the replica count in the Helm values and redeploy.
